commands.name: test
commands.summary: Run unit tests across all packages
commands.description: Invokes the "test" script in every project. Projects without a "test" script are skipped. Respects the dependency order so upstream packages are tested first.

commands.name: lint
commands.description: Invokes the "lint" script in every project. Projects without a "lint" script are skipped. Runs in parallel because linting does not depend on build order.

commands.name: typecheck
commands.summary: Run TypeScript type checking across all packages
commands.description: Invokes the "typecheck" script in every project. Respects build order so type definitions from upstream packages are available when downstream packages are checked.

commands.name: size
commands.summary: Check bundle-size budgets across all packages
commands.description: Invokes the "size" script in every project that declares one. Packages without a "sizeLimit" field are skipped; a budget is only meaningful where bundle size is something a consumer pays for.

commands.name: docs
commands.summary: Regenerate the API reference across all packages
commands.description: Invokes the "docs" script in every project that defines one. The generated markdown is committed, which gives it the authority of a reviewed file and none of the guarantees of a build artefact — so it is regenerated and diffed in CI rather than trusted.
